title: Reject ambiguous ELF mappings in bounded literal discovery
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/h25-elf-literal-discovery-controls`, an isolated archive of a completed bounded source/control component. The v2 ELF candidate-discovery helper rejects (1) a file-unique literal with a competing virtual LOAD mapping, including partial or zero-fill overlap, and (2) a non-executable entry whose file bytes are aliased by an executable LOAD at another virtual address. The exact rejected v1 source, independent M01/M02 objections, repair diff, and accepted v2 source are retained.

The completed component has 23 passing NEW synthetic cases in normal mode and 23 in optimized mode over 20 literal buffers, independently reviewed from the retained raw outputs, grant, tool receipts and ledger. This is candidate discovery and finite synthetic control evidence only. The actual-inspection round closed partial at 23:55:37 UTC on 2026-11-02 without accepting any actual-image inspection checkpoint. No actual GCC image pass, helper.main/decoder execution, actual 60-second grant, operational prefix certificate or feasibility acceptance occurred. The v2/v3 capture guard remains REJECT/HOLD because close can overwrite the first read/pin/write failure; inert reviews and full closure receipt preserve that blocker, with no guard executable exported.

Full compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign remain false. Physical costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. No kappa, speedup, supplier admission, selected-frontier change, or completed actual-inspection checkpoint is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6454](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6454).

Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, tree `e6898c8ba7a27b71587c32ba3f639259ceeeed91`. Explicit user-directed incremental prerequisite publication; scope is changed from the pinned portable-replay catalogue card, which supplies genuine infrastructure provenance only. No picker or unrelated task was run.

Related: #6397 (criterion), #6362 (input constructors), #6434 (raw pilot error accounting), and #6454 (conditional phase frame; observed head `e83090c937b920affc87593f02b535e6c9773615`). This package adds the separate pure literal-discovery mapping repair and finite controls; it does not claim predecessor work. Parent's bounded related-PR graph covers 39 nodes/29 edges; historical heads and finite search limits remain explicit. No exhaustive novelty or incorporation claim follows. #6454's hosted run 41547936328 attempt 1 completed success with replay skipped, supplying no candidate/native/scientific replay credit.

The package is self-contained for its registered synthetic controls. Exact source origins, Git blob IDs, SHA256, sizes and 100644 modes are recorded in SOURCE-MAP/MANIFEST. All transitive executable inputs are package-local: the frozen v2 helper, builder and harness, plus Python standard library. Historical absolute paths in protocol and evidence are inert. A known unrelated base PDF Git blob remains missing in the local alternate and is not repaired or presented as complete object availability.

## Validation

Historical accepted evidence: helper source review `cdf88f0eeaff9ca22d9964a086875a43b5e87a0647de41c4b637129acb553f37`; separate controls-execution review `a7bb90acc80f519af72abd87993c31c0b2c3a938d0a6e29508daee7c589520d7`; ledger `4955efcccf2160f87e75ab02dfca82da6ed733e2690bad8a65dfd15e4f64c7b9`. The full closed-round receipt is `e8fc63616c75ad6dd5b5b69620764e29f7e6040ad292c5a5924cd6027a5e2c93`.

GNU wall 0.16/0.17 seconds and tool wall 0.065126715/0.071047239 remain separately retained. The declared policy charged 0.35 seconds total; supplemental combined policy time at that historical component checkpoint was 100.130533479 seconds and canonical 94.550533479 seconds is unchanged. Individual GNU RSS is not complete tree peak or a full physical-cost bill.

Reproduction is documented in the package README. VERIFY.json registers only the normal/-O publication adapter. It resolves its own directory, pins the exact 8023-byte frozen harness before compiling those SAME bytes in a fresh non-main module with absolute __file__, then calls only its main with the absolute sibling v2 helper path and fixed hash. The upstream runner supplies a relative package string; this transparent adapter preserves the unchanged absolute-path requirement and all three accepted source files. Unexpected wrapper arguments are refused. The harness checks source bytes before executing those same bytes in fresh non-main modules, calls only inspect on literal buffers, and keeps explicit requirements active under -O. C01/C02 require real Stop outcomes. The standalone static integrity checker reads bytes/JSON only and is not a registered execution of helper.main. It accepts exactly 0644 or read-only 0444 physical permissions with logical Git 100644, rejects links/executable permissions, and checks the file-length cap before and after reading.

Parent A-I validation of preserved v3 commit `4dda053c39b11d16da387440a7c07b4450f5edbd` passed, with independent execution/committed-export review `d1a42da686b482a07e78231ef35cdab615a3f87a209236fcc34c38a7512617bd`. Evidence includes static integrity, official metadata/normal 23/optimized 23, committed-byte/source-history/modes, official committed export, read-only cold static/normal 23/optimized 23, and expected one-byte harness tamper refusal (exit 2). Total added A-I policy debit was 3.17 seconds; supplemental combined policy time is 103.300533479, canonical 94.550533479 is unchanged, and physical costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. These exact code/fixture/control outcomes are reused only because all five Python files, VERIFY and scientific/raw evidence remain byte-identical. This v4 successor changes exactly README, SCOPE, SOURCE-MAP and MANIFEST to correct qualification-category labels; the erroneous v3 snapshot and complete evidence remain preserved. The correction distinguishes complete-stage qualification from overall-milestone qualification; complete compiler-input closure and bootstrap verification remain false. Current v4 parent-owned metadata checks all passed: static integrity; official committed-byte/source-history/modes preflight; official export and check-inputs; exact 56-file/305,834-byte checked read-only copy; and read-only static integrity. Current tar SHA256 is 24047aa10d346db522ed89fd4801983bc473f2b068b362662ea669c65871428e. Independent v4 reporting/delta/invalidation review bc0cdeaffdc904a9c37152879d444ac5b2356b58dcb1971ebaa742f2e1fa86f0 accepts exact unchanged-code evidence reuse and rejects the old qualification labels. Metadata-only ledger 73c41786f3bd694cfdad753b3bbba51fa68a4757868be29ac0b90b57df9a7f1c adds 1.59 policy seconds, giving supplemental combined 104.890533479 seconds; canonical 94.550533479 remains unchanged. No new v4 local synthetic-control or tamper replay was performed. V4 local commit `d776c09f8817cffe0dbe7b3021eda775dfa2b247`, tree `ac6eebceca1f56d8a177ea1fd0fe2bba02f7898c`, has sole parent `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` and exactly 56 additions. Normal git write-tree succeeded in the earlier v3 phase; --missing-ok was not used. The unrelated missing base PDF remains unrepaired. The fork publication and Chrome submission use this exact reviewed tree. Current-head hosted checks and public handoff will be recorded in the delivery comment, with any pending/skipped status preserved. No actual-image/helper.main/decoder/native/scientific/Lean/full historical suite, new budget or actual round was authorized by this reporting correction.

`S04` checks unvalidated interior candidates; `S06` checks that an overwritten literal is not promoted. Semantic falsifiers for role/reachability (`S11`), relocation effects (`S12`), and private calls/aliases (`S13`) remain unimplemented. These are test-case identifiers in the retained control index. Finite metadata buffers are not claimed to be genuine kernel-loadable executables.

## Credit

Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including assigned GPT-6.1 Sol Max authoring and independent AI source/evidence reviews. Those reviews are not human or proof-kernel acceptance. Predecessor credit and exact LICENSE/NOTICE snapshots are retained; the genuine base contributor index remains pinned in SOURCES.json. New material is Apache-2.0. No GCC source/binary or external decoder is vendored, and no license claim about external executables is made.

## Open next questions

See TASK.json and README. The immediate blocker is first-error preservation through close/cleanup in a separately authorized source round; review the exact frozen objections before considering any genuine actual-image admission. Boundary/role/relocation/private-call qualification would then need its own concrete admission and bounded plan. The current inspection round is closed; this PR does not reopen it, authorize a repair or actual run, add funding, or resume the separate paused application goal.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Separating accepted helper/control evidence from the rejected capture guard permits useful component publication while preserving the actual round's negative result and unchanged original credit.
